- Overall performance: Revenue after eliminations is $1.91 billion with a gross margin of 40.2% and EBITDA margin of 16.7%.
- The company that contributes most to revenue is Wipro GE Healthcare with $1.15 billion, while Wipro Kawasaki Precision Machinery needs attention with lower margins of 36.2% gross and 14.8% EBITDA.
- Margins are 40.2% for gross and 16.7% for EBITDA.
- Working capital as of 2026-07-01 is managed with 69 days of DSO and 79 days of DPO.
- Top 3 revenue drivers are: everything excluding profit centre EQ, revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves with a $0.03 billion change (35% of total change), revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves excluding profit centre EQ with a $0.02 billion change (25.9% of total change), and revenue account Sales - Hydraulic Pumps excluding profit centre EQ with a $0.01 billion change (17.1% of total change).
